watches.name: GNS1.2 «Arrows»
watches.description: The Art of Motion Time in Perpetual Flight Time is not static—it moves, it evolves, it flows like an arrow in flight. The GNS1.2 Arrows Collection captures this kinetic energy, transforming the passage of time into a visual and mechanical spectacle. Inspired by the elegance of precision and movement, this timepiece redefines watchmaking, blending bold […]

specsRaw.Materials: 18K white or 4N rose gold, Grade 5 titanium, or Damascene Titanium
specsRaw.Crystal: domed “Glass box” sapphire crystal on the dial side; open-view case back with sapphire crystal – both crystals with anti-reflective coating
specsRaw.Crown: 18K white or 4N rose gold, Grade 5 titanium, or Damascene Titanium; raised G-E-N-U-S letters on circumference provide winding grip
specsRaw.Caliber: Created, designed, and assembled in-house in the GENUS workshops in Geneva. The manual winding movement is divided into two parts: one dedicated to energy generation and transmission; the other to energy distribution and regulation
specsRaw.Regulating organ: Swiss lever escapement, variable inertia balance wheel
specsRaw.Hours: 12 satellites/peripheral and axial rotation indexes (patent pending)
specsRaw.Tens of minutes: 12 free-moving elements circulate between 2 counter rotating wheels (patent pending)
specsRaw.Strap Materials: Exotic leathers, standard leathers, and textured rubber in a variety of colors
specsRaw.Pin Buckle Materials: 18K white or 4N rose gold, Grade 5 titanium, or Damascene Titanium

watches.name: GNS1.2«Dragon»
watches.description: Legends Woven in Time A Mythical Creature Brought to Life For centuries, dragons have captured the imagination of civilizations across the world—symbols of power, wisdom, and eternal cycles. The GNS1.2 Dragon Collection is where these legendary creatures find their place in the heart of Haute Horlogerie, their sinuous forms intertwined with the passage of time. […]

specsRaw.Materials: Grade 5 titanium, Damascene Titanium, 18K rose gold 4N color, or 18K white gold
specsRaw.Crystals: Domed “glass box” sapphire crystal on the dial side; open view case back with sapphire crystal – both crystals with anti-reflective coating
specsRaw.Crown: Material as per the case; raised G-E-N-U-S letters on circumference provide winding grip
specsRaw.Caliber: 260xx-2, hand-wound, manufactured in the GENUS workshops in Geneva. The movement is divided into two parts: one dedicated to energy generation and transmission; the other to energy distribution and regulation
specsRaw.Regulating organ: Swiss lever escapement, variable inertia balance wheel
specsRaw.Hours: 12 satellites/indices with peripheral and axial rotation (patent pending)
specsRaw.Tens-of-minutes: 11 free-moving elements circulating between two counter-rotating foci (patent pending), stylized in the shape of a dragon, in 18K gold and hand-engraved.
specsRaw.Buckle: Pin buckle material as per the case, with GENUS logo engraving

watches.name: GNS1.2«Gems»
watches.description: L’Éclat du Temps Quand l’Horlogerie Rencontre la Haute Joaillerie Le temps, tel un joyau précieux, est éternel, façonné par la lumière, le mouvement et la précision. La collection GNS1.2 Gems transforme le temps en un spectacle lumineux, alliant la maîtrise mécanique de GENUS à l’éclat intemporel des pierres précieuses. Plus qu’une montre, chaque pièce est […]

specsRaw.Matériaux: Or gris18 carats ou or rose 18 carats couleur 4N, titane grade 5, ou titane damassé
specsRaw.Verres: Verre saphir bombé« glass box » côté cadran ; fond avec verre saphir – les deux verres sont traités antireflet
specsRaw.Couronne: Titane grade 5 ; les lettres G-E-N-U-S en relief pour une meilleure prise en main

specsRaw.Matériaux de la boucle ardillon: Or gris 18 carats ou or rose 18 carats couleur 4N, titane damascène ou titane grade 5.
